findSong.label: the Songs search box (the list filters as you type and its first match is selected)

show.label: the blue play button under the song list: "Add to playlist and present immediately"

clear.label: the curtain button at the top of the Presenter pane

next.label: the next-slide arrow under the Presenter pane (there only while something is presented)

previous.label: the previous-slide arrow under the Presenter pane (there only while something is presented)
